parameter.table_enabled_hint: Filter relevant tables and datasources for each question. When disabled, retain all accessible candidates.
parameter.table_candidates_hint: Table candidate count is not a final table limit: explicitly mentioned tables and related tables are retained. Datasource count limits vector candidates before the model selects a datasource.
parameter.table_weight_hint: Vector weight ranges from 0 to 1; keyword weight is 1 minus this value.
parameter.table_matching_hybrid_hint: Match tables using vector similarity and keywords. Use vector matching when no keywords are extracted.
parameter.table_matching_vector_hint: Enable keyword extraction to adjust hybrid matching weights.
parameter.table_matching_unfiltered_hint: Keep all accessible candidate tables. Enable vector filtering for tables and datasources and keyword extraction to adjust hybrid matching weights.
parameter.keyword_enabled_hint: Extract keywords from the question to match terminology. Keywords also contribute to table matching when vector filtering for tables and datasources is enabled.
parameter.knowledge_candidates_hint: Candidate counts apply to vector recall. Literal matches and multiple keywords can increase the final injected knowledge count. Saved settings apply to new tasks.
